4_bit.verdict: none taken: the best candidate beats reading the bytes linearly by 9%, which does not separate from the null, so a 4-bit raster is listed and not drawn

8_bit.verdict: taken: it beats reading the bytes linearly by 232%

gs_layout_measurement.method: Candidate GS layouts scored on 30 rasters of the retail 2002 disc by the mean absolute difference between horizontally adjacent decoded RGB values; real art is locally coherent and a wrong layout destroys that. Lower is more coherent.

identity_note: Derived, never confirmed: no PCSX2 texture dump of either Blitz disc exists in this project, so a name is what the emulator's documented rules compute from the raster's own bytes and no more.
note: Counts and sizes only. No pixel, palette entry or texture name is here.
